findings.evidenceJa: 赤い男に庇われながら
findings.governingReading: while being shielded by the man in red
findings.explanation: Archer’s active protection of Rin is reduced to her location behind him.

findings.governingReading: a slight pain runs through me
findings.explanation: Command Spell expenditure changes from slight pain to sharp pain.

findings.evidenceJa: 左手の甲に刻まれた印
findings.governingReading: marks engraved on the back of my left hand
findings.explanation: The location and inscription of the Command Spells are reduced to an unspecified hand.

findings.evidenceJa: 銀の甲冑が石化したかのように停止する
findings.governingReading: the silver armor stops as though turned to stone
findings.explanation: The Command Spell’s absolute arrest becomes voluntary hesitation.

findings.evidenceJa: 彼女を斬り殺してしまう
findings.governingReading: her cut the girl down and kill her
findings.explanation: Shirou’s horror at Rin being killed is softened into seeing Saber slash at her.

findings.highlight: the girl in her school uniform
findings.evidenceJa: それを押しのけて前に出る制服姿の少女
findings.governingReading: a uniformed girl pushing past him to step forward
findings.explanation: Rin physically taking the foreground from Archer is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺が魔術を習っている
findings.explanation: An ongoing, limited course of instruction becomes possession of generic magic knowledge.

findings.governingReading: I doubt it, but let me make sure
findings.explanation: Rin’s incredulous preface becomes an assertion that her own question is impossible.

findings.evidenceJa: なんとも半端なのを使う
findings.governingReading: what a half-baked discipline to specialize in
findings.explanation: Rin criticizes Strengthening as an incomplete or middling specialization, not as intrinsically strange magic.

findings.highlight: There’s no spell needed to activate it
findings.evidenceJa: 発動に呪文は必要なくて
findings.governingReading: No incantation is required to activate it
findings.explanation: The verbal incantation requirement is confused with a spell, even though the Command Spell itself has just been defined as a spell.

findings.evidenceJa: 望みを叶える聖杯が与えられる
findings.governingReading: is granted the Holy Grail that will fulfill their wish
findings.explanation: The stated reward loses the essential reason it is desired.

findings.evidenceJa: あまりにも潔かった誰かの声
findings.explanation: The defining quality of Rin’s unseen intervention is misread as moral or tonal purity.

findings.highlight: too brief for me to understand
findings.evidenceJa: 実感を得るには遠すぎた
findings.governingReading: far too remote for it to feel real
findings.explanation: Shirou’s inability to internalize the explanation becomes inability to comprehend it.

findings.evidenceJa: 死亡した伝説上の英雄
findings.governingReading: a legendary hero who has died
findings.explanation: The basic qualification that the summoned hero is dead is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 降霊術とか口寄せとか
findings.explanation: Two examples of ordinary spirit-handling arts are collapsed into an invented quoted category and a misleading gloss.

findings.highlight: uses heroic spirits to make miracles happen
findings.evidenceJa: 英霊の力の一部を借り受けて奇蹟を起こす
findings.governingReading: borrow part of a Heroic Spirit’s power to work miracles
findings.explanation: The key contrast—ordinary arts borrow only part of the Heroic Spirit’s power—is removed.

findings.highlight: familiars made from the heroic spirits themselves
findings.evidenceJa: 英霊本体を直接連れてきて使い魔にする
findings.governingReading: bring the Heroic Spirit itself here directly and make it a familiar
findings.explanation: Directly importing the original spiritual being becomes constructing a familiar from it.
Shirou’s explicit moral and aesthetic condemnation of the war disappears.
